meta.unit: one unit = one settled drop of 6 lumps (one stack)
meta.convention: Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by; rotations R_u=C R_b C^-1
meta.frame_obj: Bunker.obj (forward -Z, up Y, triangulated, no materials)
meta.fill_order: units[] is in fill order (drop round, then bay). Each unit's copies carry their FINAL settled pose, so a stack is placed exactly as listed; earlier units never move when later ones are added (each drop landed on the frozen earlier ones).
meta.pivot: copy offset locates the item's bounds centre; scale multiplies the item's natural prefab scale
meta.item_hint: one material per bay: bay 0 (Unity +x side) / 1 / 2 hold render_item; the mod places whatever item the stack holds
meta.simulation: Blender rigid body: lumps CONVEX_HULL margin 0.003, friction 0.8, restitution 0, damping 0.45/0.85, box colliders for floor/walls/dividers/leaning back wall; substeps 20, solver iterations 30, 24 fps; settled when max step < 0.25 mm and < 0.15 deg over 6 frames
